auditor_olivia: Hi all — auditor here. We noticed an RBAC change (rolebinding rb-2021) during emergency vuln triage for CVE-2026-0999 on 2026-11-03. For SOC2 evidence we need: 1) raw CloudTrail/KMS events for 2026-11-03T02:00Z–03:00Z showing any GenerateDataKey/Decrypt activity, 2) HSM/EKM wrapproofs or signed attestations (if HSM used), 3) a concise rollback timeline/note, 4) the remediation PR and deploy IDs, and 5) confirmation (or diff) if any CMK key policy edits occurred in that window. Please provide presigned S3 paths and a one-line mapping to CC6.2 and ISO A.9.2.

sam-security: Thanks @auditor_olivia — we'll collect raw CloudTrail JSON + SIEM correlation. Quick Q: do you want the CloudTrail raw compressed JSON or a filtered export just for the key id?

auditor_olivia: Raw compressed CloudTrail JSON preferred; filtered exports OK as supplemental. Also include any SIEM rule IDs and the canary alert ID.

joel-sre: Copy. Building a tarball now. Expect presigned bucket: s3://redwood-evidence/2101112222/ with files: 
- cloudtrail_kms_2101112222.json.gz 
- siem_rbac_alerts_2101112222.log.gz (rule ids: SIEM-8701, SIEM-8702) 
- rb-2021-rollback.txt 
- cve-0999-mitigation.md 
- manifest.sha256.sig 

hana-eng: Rollback note (brief):
"Revert rb-2021 applied 2026-11-03T02:14:37Z by hana-eng via ops-runbook v5.0 after canary detected broadened write scope to secrets-store. Revert completed 02:26Z; post-revert canary green at 02:32Z. Ticket: IR-8120."

sam-security: CloudTrail snippet (excerpt):
```
{
  "eventTime": "2026-11-03T02:09:18Z",
  "eventName": "GenerateDataKey",
  "userIdentity": { "type": "AssumedRole", "arn": "arn:aws:sts::123456789012:assumed-role/redwood-rbac-agent/agent-2021" },
  "requestParameters": { "keyId": "arn:aws:kms:us-west-2:123456789012:key/hh11-kk22" },
  "responseElements": { "ciphertextBlob": "..." }
}
```

sam-security: We also pulled KMS Decrypt events for the window and saw no Decrypts with externalRecipient or `recipientInfo` fields — all Decrypts attributable to internal assumed roles.

joel-sre: HSM/EKM side: we did use the EKM connector for this key. Uploaded HSM wrap logs to s3://redwood-evidence/2101112222/hsm_wrap.log.gz. Excerpt: `EKM_WRAP: 2026-11-03T02:10:00Z wrap key=hh11-kk22 caller=rbac-agent-2021 recipient=local result=OK`. No remote wrap peers.

hsm-ops-bot: Automated attestation: created signed HSM attestation attestation-2101112222.json.sig (signer: hsm-ops-key ck-41) and uploaded to s3://redwood-evidence/2101112222/hsm-attestation.sig. Attestation contains HSM serial, wrap operation IDs, and verifier signature.

auditor_olivia: Great. Two follow-ups: 1) paste the first line of rb-2021-rollback.txt here for the packet; 2) provide PR link and deploy IDs for the CVE fix. Also, please confirm whether PutKeyPolicy/DisableKey/ScheduleKeyDeletion/PutKeyRotation or UpdateKeyDescription events exist for key hh11-kk22 in 01:30–03:30Z window.

hana-eng: rb-2021-rollback.txt (first line): "Revert rb-2021 applied 2026-11-03T02:14:37Z by hana-eng — canary flagged expanded secrets write permission."

joel-sre: CVE PR: https://git.redwood.ai/infra/security/pull/1899
Deploys: deploy-usw2-20261103-11, canary-20261103-2

sam-security: Confirming key policy events: no PutKeyPolicy, DisableKey, ScheduleKeyDeletion, PutKeyRotation, or UpdateKeyDescription events for hh11-kk22 between 2026-11-03T01:30Z and 2026-11-03T03:30Z. We did find an unrelated administrative rotation on 2026-10-20.

auditor_olivia: Thanks — please append a one-line mapping to manifest.sha256.sig tying these artifacts to CC6.2 and ISO A.9.2 (detection + remediation) and ensure HSM attestation signer id is present. If needed I'll request a notarized/signed HSM attestation screenshot.

hsm-ops-bot: Updated manifest-signed entry: 
- CC6.2: RBAC change + rollback + CloudTrail/KMS and HSM attestation demonstrate detection and remediation within SLO.
- ISO A.9.2: Access rights adjustment and emergency rollback executed; no evidence of external key export (EKM logs and attestation show local wrap only).

auditor_olivia: Perfect — I'll include these in the SOC2/ISO deliverable. If we need additional screenshots or a short signed attestation from HSM ops lead, I'll follow up. :thumbsup:
